notes:
• Law-firm CI for citations: Settings ▸ Citation now lets you pick the font and size for every citation LitArbi inserts into Word (default: keep the document's own footnote style). “Update Exhibits in Document” re-applies it, so updates keep the firm's look.
• The Word add-in can now frame its citations in a content control — the Exhibit-Manager-style box that shows while editing and never prints (Settings ▸ Add-ins; reinstall the add-in to get the new version).
